creator: Lingonberry contributors
method: Original Korean sentence translations authored in the current conversation; no external example bank or dictionary prose copied.

entries.sentence: I usually do my homework before dinner.
entries.translation: 나는 보통 저녁을 먹기 전에 숙제를 한다.

entries.sentence: After getting up, I make my bed by straightening the sheets.
entries.translation: 나는 일어난 뒤 시트를 반듯하게 펴서 침대를 정돈한다.

entries.sentence: Please bring the speech to a conclusion; we have only a minute left.
The team will carry out an analysis of the recorded interviews.
entries.translation: 그 팀은 인터뷰 기록을 분석할 것이다.

entries.sentence: Get up and leave your bed; it is time for breakfast.
entries.translation: 일어나서 침대에서 나오세요. 아침 먹을 시간이에요.

entries.sentence: It is morning. Get up and leave your bed; breakfast is ready.
entries.translation: 아침이에요. 일어나서 침대에서 나오세요. 아침 식사가 준비됐어요.
